overview.description: The Texas Capital Texas Equity Index ETF (TXS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Texas Capital Texas Equity index. The fund invests in various industries, sectors, and sizes. Components are selected by market-cap. TXS was launched on Jul 12, 2023 and is issued by Texas Capital.

data.title: ETFs on TXSE: A Big Milestone for Y'all Street
data.text: The Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE) is more than a regional milestone — it is a shift in competition among U.S. capital markets.
